notes.title: 5.0 Update Note
notes.content:
Game has been updated to version 5.0. All players are advised to update to the latest version to experience the new content.

**Update Details:**

[h2]New Content[/h2]
1. Added an experience and level system. Correspondingly, new talents using level upgrades have been added to the Spiritual Fountain talent tree interface. The amount of experience gained is related to difficulty.
2. Added ancient equipment. After difficulty level 10, legendary or higher quality equipment has a small chance to become ancient equipment, with a random attribute enhanced to 1.6 times its maximum value.
3. Added two ring equipment slots and dark gold quality equipment. Dark gold equipment comes with a passive skill and random 1-4 dark gold potentials.
4. After difficulty level 10, added gameplay one: clearing this level drops the final arena key. The arena challenge opened by the key involves continuous small monster battles. Surviving 24 waves guarantees a drop of one dark gold ring. Each subsequent wave increases monster difficulty by one level, and there is a small chance of dropping dark gold rings until death.
5. After difficulty level 10, added gameplay two: the final challenge against Mimir. In Chapter 5, you can initiate a battle with Mimir. Mimir cannot be killed, so do your best to deal damage before dying. After the battle unlocks the enhancement platform, which can activate dark gold equipment potentials (by consuming ancient equipment to gain ancient affixes).
6. Added a batch of new attributes:
   1. Four types of weapon mastery, independently increasing damage.
   2. Suppression chance and suppression damage multiplier, initially 3% and 150%. Any damage triggering suppression will duplicate this damage by 150%, creating new damage. When the final critical hit rate exceeds 100%, every 2 points of critical hit rate convert to 1 point of suppression chance.
   3. Added endurance damage reduction and endurance threshold-related attributes. When current health reaches the endurance threshold, the player gains additional endurance damage reduction effects.
   4. Added a batch of spell point damage attributes, increasing the base point damage of corresponding spells.
7. Adjusted the random types and quantities of rune affixes.
8. An art book DLC has been added, covering most of the original artwork and design content of the game (a condensed version of the art book will be available for free at a later date, currently under review on Steam).

[h2]System Adjustments[/h2]
1. The weapon system has been adjusted. There are now twelve initial weapons to choose from, derived from the original sword, axe, spear, and katana. Each weapon's divine blessing now includes a corresponding ultimate talent.
2. The difficulty value of levels has been significantly compressed. Now, 20 levels are approximately equal to the original 100 levels.
3. Rune forging can now be performed multiple times, upgrading rune enhancement skills. Additionally, the effects of dark gold runes and dark gold ring rune forging have been added.
4. Adjusted the effects of some runes, sets, and blessings.

[h2]Notes[/h2]
Due to the significant adjustments in this update, save files are not compatible with versions prior to 4.0. 
It is strongly recommended to play the new version for a fresh gaming experience. 
If you want to play the previous version using your old save data, please select the old version when starting the game.

[*] Added Valkyrie development, which becomes available after the first clearance.
[*] Each Valkyrie skin has its basic attribute skill and exclusive skill. In addition to the skill of the currently used Valkyrie skin, you can also choose another Valkyrie as an assistant to activate their basic attribute skill.
[*] After defeating the Fire Nation leader with the Valkyrie's basic skill, you can upgrade it 3-7 times based on the time taken for the timed clearance (the clearance difficulty should be higher than the skill level of the Valkyrie).
[*] After the Valkyrie's basic skill reaches level 20, their exclusive skill will be unlocked.
[*] Using any Valkyrie will activate the Valkyrie's Guardian passive skill, which comprehensively improves attack and defense capabilities. The skill level is determined by the highest-level Valkyrie.
[*] After the Valkyrie's basic skill reaches level 50, you can receive a new mission. By consuming materials at the Valkyrie, you can create Spiritual Water and sublimate a designated rune to maximize its attributes. Each Valkyrie can only create one Spiritual Water.
[/olist]

[h1]New Gameplay - Deep Key Challenge in the Hall of Heroes[/h1]
[olist]
[*] After clearing level 20 difficulty, the Deep Key Challenge in the Hall of Heroes will be unlocked. After defeating the Fire Nation leader, you will receive several challenge keys based on the current difficulty. Use the challenge keys to enter.
[*] In the key challenge mode, a new map will be introduced for four consecutive boss challenges (the boss order is random and determined by the challenge key).
[*] This mode provides a large number of blessings and powerful runes. It also allows unlimited free recasting to conveniently verify different playstyles.
[*] Defeating the bosses in the key challenge will have a chance to drop a new equipment item, the Blessed Necklace, which carries a random blessing skill and 1-3 different attributes (the attribute entries and values are affected by the challenge difficulty).
[*] The necklace is a brand-new equipment slot, and currently, only the Blessed Necklace is available in the game.
[/olist]

[h1]Adjustments to Meat Pigeon Gameplay[/h1]
[olist]
[*] The rune enhancement reward teleporter has been removed. Now, bosses will drop a fixed enhanced rune.
[*] The rune enhancement skill can be upgraded multiple times. Once you choose a particular direction, you cannot choose another rune enhancement skill in a different direction.
[*] The set effects of equipment runes no longer require the activation of rune enhancement skills. They can be activated by meeting the required number of set pieces.
[*] A new teleporter for spell skill rewards has been added. Upon entering, it will only drop the corresponding spell skill.
[*] The blessings skills rewarded in the first two levels of Chapter One have been optimized, and most of the later skills have been removed. The focus is on passive skills that generate spell-based effects to optimize the early game experience.
[*] The number of enemy waves in Chapter Three and Chapter Four has been reduced. Correspondingly, the drop probability of gold coins from enemies has been increased, and the time limit for timed challenges has been adjusted.
[*] The values in the first 20 floors have been compressed to accelerate the early game transition. The difficulty cap in the saved progress will also be proportionally scaled to avoid excessively high difficulty (now, Difficulty 1 is equivalent to Difficulty 15 in version 2.0 (enemy attack power remains largely unchanged, while health is 1.5-2.5 times higher than the original version), and Difficulty 20 is equivalent to the original Difficulty 70. The subsequent changes in values per floor remain the same).
[*] The difficulty for the Chest Challenge has been reduced to Difficulty 5, and the difficulty for the Fire Nation Trial has been reduced to Difficulty 10.
[*] The Chest Challenge has added additional random rewards: +2 recast attempts and either 100 gold coins or a random spell skill book.
[*] Choosing the teleporter to restore health will provide an additional 10% increase to the maximum health limit as a clearance reward.
[/olist]

[h1]Translation into English: Skill Value Adjustments[/h1]
1. Adjusted the calculation method for critical strike rate. Now, critical strike rate is divided into base critical strike rate and critical strike rate bonus. Only a few talents provide base critical strike rate, while the critical strike rate bonus is a percentage increase applied to the base rate (significantly increasing the values of skills that provide critical strike rate bonus).
2. Strengthened the effects of most rune enhancement skills. Each rune enhancement skill can be upgraded multiple times.
3. Enhanced and adjusted the effects of certain hero blessing skills.
       a. Independent damage increase changes: All effects of independent damage increase skills are marked with a yellow (X).
      [list]
[*] Last Stand: Damage increased by 50% when own health is below 30%, changed to independent damage increase.
[*]       Power of the Ancient Runes: Independent damage increase effect reduced from 30% to 15%.
[*]       Self-Discipline: Damage increase effect changed from 70% independent damage increase to 150% overall damage bonus.
[/list]
       b. Storm Arrow Enhancement:
    [list]
[*]   Ultimate Storm: Damage taken from Storm Arrows increased by 40% changed to 10%, and stack limit changed from 5 to 99.
[*]       Storm's Eye: Damage taken from Storm Arrows increased by 150% changed to 500%.
[/list]
       c. Hammer of Thor:
    [list]
[*]   Base limit increased from 5 stacks to 20 stacks, and mutually exclusive stack limit increased from 60 stacks to 99 stacks.
[*]       Fixed an issue where the increased duration effect of Hammer of Thor did not take effect in the mutually exclusive stack state.
[*]       Optimized the logic consumption of Hammer of Thor, it will no longer create additional collision entities, reducing lag.
[/list]
      d. Curse of Hela:
    [list]
[*]   Fixed an issue where Curse of Hela repeatedly calculated damage between different enemies, causing lag.
[*]       Fixed an issue where Curse of Hela's damage calculation applied multiple overall damage bonuses, now it will only correctly apply one overall damage bonus.
[/list]
      e. Formation of Freya:
      [list]
[*] Reworked Freya's Strike: When enemies are hit by normal attacks or power attacks within the Formation of Freya, they take additional true damage equal to the remaining damage of all Formation of Freya effects.
[/list]
       f. Added four advanced survival blessings:
    [list]
[*]   Agility: After using a spell skill, damage taken is reduced by 50% for 9 seconds.
[*]       Guardian of the Mind: When energy is above 90%, damage taken is reduced by 50%.
[*]       Energy Conversion: 60% of damage taken is converted into energy reduction.
[*]       Power of the Shield: Shield value is increased by an additional 30%.
[/list]
4. Redesigned the effects of most set skills (see in-game for details) and added a four-piece Berserker's Fury set (2-piece set only):
[list]
[*]       Wolf Fury:educes damage taken by 60% and provides additional attack power bonus based on the remaining time, increasing by 1% every 1 second.
[*]       Eagle Fury:Randomly grants 70% damage reduction or 60% evasion with each rotation.
[*]       Excess healing and kill recovery effects in the state of the  Bear's Fury offset the bleeding effect of the  Bear's Fury (converted according to the remaining time ratio).
[*]       Shield generated by the Crow's Fury provides a 20% armor bonus if it is shattered within its duration, and a 20% damage bonus if it disappears over time. Lasts for 12 seconds, can stack, and has independent timers.
[/list]
5. Adjusted the triggering coefficient effects. Now, for triggering effects, when the final triggering coefficient exceeds 200%, there is a chance of triggering the effect multiple times (1 additional trigger for every 200% triggering probability).

[h1]Enemy Adjustments[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Weakened the AI of Fenrir, reducing the frequency of its skill releases, increasing the cooldown time of ranged skills and charge skills by 10 seconds, and starting in cooldown.
[/olist]

[h1]Other Adjustments[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Optimized the UI of the backpack, added the ability to drag and drop items to change their positions, and the positions of backpack items will be saved in the archive for easier organization and planning.
[*] The backpack interface has added filtering by set name.
[*] The settings menu has added a switch for HUD compact mode, which can change the character status bar to be displayed near the skill bar.
[*] The character's health bar now displays the current shield value.
[*] The menu interface has added a simple global damage statistics feature.
[/olist]

[h1]Other[/h1]
Introduced the 2.0 Classic Server, the testing code is [2ClassicBranch]. Right-click in the library, go to Properties, then Testing, and enter the code to play the 2.0 version again.
   (Due to different version data, the save files are separate, so starting a new save file is required for the Classic version.)

notes.title: A letter to players of "Forbidden Trials" 2

Here, thank you again to the leaders of Q Group Pioneer Test. Kowtow.jpg

This time we will launch the new challenge map, new genre, affix, camera system, etc. in the main body update system. Including the defeat map of the main character that will be updated in the future, weapon skin updates, etc., they are all available to everyone without spending any money. Of course, some people may think that your development team is just a bitch and has to build a memorial arch. You don't like the character strength payment model of mobile games, but you also have to pay for character items. The main reason is that we really don’t know how to maintain the resource investment required for normal updates of a game and how to develop a good business model. We can only apply the experience of senior game developers who can continue to update the game for a long time. (I do want to add a new weapon system, but this is really too much work)
3. Regarding the quality issues of DLC characters raised by everyone, the quality of the models is not as good as that of the main characters. We feel that most of the earliest original characters have female body types, with Yujie style, ascetic style, and Sanwu style. I would like to try some new things: Loli (never smelting copper) and Furui Xiang. I take full responsibility for failing to consider the needs of the public. Personally, I prefer this one (it’s considered a private product), and I want to make XP richer. In addition, we will also hear different voices from players, hoping that some serious characters can be broadcast live or played in public view. Anyway, I will listen to your opinions more in the future: black and white silk, dead stock water, black long straight, villain sister, and wedding dress series may be something you are willing to see. understood.

Of course, we also think that everyone will like the impossible character content. If we have character DLC updates in the future, we will describe the new content more clearly on the store page, including previews of the characters. Once again, we sincerely appeal to everyone: if the character is not your XP, do not buy it! Don't buy something you don't like in order to support us. After all, no one's money comes from the strong wind. Enjoy the content of the main body and wait until you have a character that pokes fun at you before you consider buying it. Protect your wallet and be cautious first.

Let’s talk about whatever comes to mind today. As for the follow-up update plan, we will inform everyone as soon as possible after internal discussions are completed~

Thank you all for your support and opinions. Again, sometimes we can easily be blinded by a leaf and fall into a vicious circle. With your voices, Forbidden Trials will get better!

notes.title: Taboo Trial version 2.0 Update Notice
notes.content:
[h1][b]Dear players:[/b][/h1]

"Taboo Trial" will be updated to version 2.0 on September 28th at 11:00 AM. We recommend that all players update to the latest version to experience the new content.

Here are the specific updates:

[h2]New Content[/h2]
1. Added a Photo Mode, accessible from the menu.

[h2]New Gameplay Features[/h2]
1. Introduced Treasure Challenges, unlocked after completing Difficulty 10. Random treasure chests will appear in some levels, offering various material rewards upon completion.
2. Added a Time-limited Challenge in the Fire Nation, unlocked after completing Difficulty 20. A new portal has been added to the Fire Nation shop for quick access. This challenge lasts for 3 minutes, and you can earn significant rewards based on the score of timed monsters.
3. Added a new map exclusive to the Fire Nation Time-limited Challenge.
4. Introduced a new elite enemy, the Multi-Turret, which appears in Treasure Challenges and Fire Nation Time-limited Challenges.
5. Added Rune Refinement gameplay, unlocked after completing Difficulty 10. Runes can be refined by consuming materials to enhance their attributes.
6. Added Rune Fusion gameplay, unlocked after completing Difficulty 10. By consuming materials and specific runes, you can collect a Rune Enhancement skill corresponding to the rune. You can choose one collected Rune Enhancement skill before starting a game.
7. Introduced a new school effect, Flame Tornado, along with numerous corresponding rune skills, Hero's Blessings, and God's Blessings.
8. Added three achievements that unlock different poses in Photo Mode.

[h2]Attribute Adjustments[/h2]
1. Introduced Armor as a new attribute, which provides additional damage reduction. Armor can be obtained through rune properties, new talents, and various in-game blessings.
2. Added Hit Recovery and Kill Recovery. Hitting and killing enemies will restore health based on the corresponding values.
3. Introduced Skill Trigger Coefficients, affecting various trigger effects. Some multi-hit skills have coefficients lower than 1, while charging skills have coefficients greater than 1.
4. All in-game damage reduction effects have been adjusted to be independently multiplicative.

[h2]Rune Adjustments[/h2]
1. Added Rune Sets of varying qualities. Activating a specified number of Rune Sets will enhance 2-piece and 4-piece set effects simultaneously. From Difficulty 10 and above, Fire Giants will drop Rune Sets, with quantity increasing with difficulty. Fire Nation Challenge chests will also drop Rune Sets.
2. Introduced a batch of Legendary Runes. Now, various mechanistic rune skills can also be obtained from Legendary Runes.
3. The number of attributes for Legendary Runes has been increased from three to four (matching the number and scope of attributes for Rune Sets).
4. Adjusted the affix library for runes, making it more reasonable.
5. Added some survival-related affixes and loot rate-related affixes.
6. Runes sold in the Rune Shop will now allow you to select from six different positions with random qualities.

[h2]Skill and Numerical Adjustments[/h2]
1. Fixed numerous bugs where skill effects were not functioning correctly.
2. Reworked Giant Bear's Rage, as detailed in the in-game skill description.
3. Significantly enhanced Wolf Fury and Crow Fury.
4. Changed the damage bonus for Eagle Fury to independent damage.
5. Significantly boosted the numerical values of various refined attribute blessings in the game.
6. Removed the backtracking effects from survival blessings and replaced them with improvements to Hit Recovery, Kill Recovery, maximum health, and damage reduction.
7. Removed some weak effects from Hero's Blessings while strengthening most of the Hero's Blessing effects.
8. Adjusted the effects of Hero's Blessings that reduce skill cooldown times.
9. Greatly reduced the numerical values of enemies in the first and second chapters of high-difficulty levels, while slightly increasing the numerical values of enemies in the fourth chapter.
10. Now, you can obtain blessings from a maximum of three schools per game. Each time you acquire a new blessing, the weighting for blessings from the corresponding school dynamically increases.

[h2]New Talents[/h2]
1. Added a maximum level of 4 for Recasting Talents. You can now recast up to 4 times.
2. Introduced the Resurgence Talent, which grants immunity to fatal damage and restores some health once per game.
3. Added the Armor Talent, which increases base armor.

[h2]Other Adjustments[/h2]
1. Introduced three different locking settings: Smart Lock, Distance Priority, and Angle Priority, in the Settings menu under Game Configuration.
2. The menu interface will now display the names of selected blessing skills.
3. The God's Gift books in the first chapter, first stage can now be freely recast an unlimited number of times.
4. Increased the difficulty limit from 90 to 120.
5. Before Difficulty 40, the optional difficulty level for time-limited clearances has been changed from +5 to +9.
6. Optimized the lag issues in the main city.

[i]Note 1: Two new DLC characters have been added, but they are still under review by Steam and have not yet been released. They will be available as soon as they pass the review.
Note 2: The discount on Steam is also subject to time restrictions and will only be available starting from September 29th.[/i]

notes.title: A letter to the players of "Forbidden Trials"
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we are the production team of cat shine.

First of all, thank you very much for your love and care for "Forbidden Trials", and thank you for your various opinions on the game. We all read carefully one by one. The game "Forbidden Trials" has many deficiencies. Seeing everyone's praise, we are sincerely apprehensive.

I am very touched by everyone's tolerance for our games.

From the establishment of the game project to its launch, we have experienced a lot. Like-minded friends joined, and some old comrades who accompanied us along the way left, either because of reality or other reasons. In short, we have fulfilled our original promise, "Forbidden Trials" must be launched. We must go, even if we don't get the results we want after going online!

I am very happy that we did not break our promise; at the same time, I am sorry that we did not fully consider the player's playing experience, and the bugs are still beyond our imagination.

We don't want to find reasons such as insufficient testing and insufficient experience of various small teams. The reality is that on the day of launch, there are countless bugs, such as controller adaptation, performance optimization, unbalanced game runes, frame drops, collisions, character wear-through, and so on. Everyone has always said that we are more comparable to model workers in three days and one. In fact, it also reflects our lack of preparation from another aspect. A truly powerful production team should not be like this. We reflect deeply and apologize to everyone!

Two weeks have passed, and looking back, it's really like a dream. Without any publicity and promotion budget, we decided to go online naked. The QQ group has grown from only the development team and a few enthusiastic players to the current small 300 people. There are also overseas players and friends who are eloquent and carefully evaluate the composition. In just two weeks, we have grown a lot and gained a lot.

Thank you to the old comrades who walked with us. With your dedication, today's "Trial of the Taboo" will be possible.
Thanks to you in the QQ group, with your cooperation, we can quickly locate the bugs of the game and improve them.
Thank you for your evaluation on steam. With your encouragement, we have more motivation to move forward. (I read the comments while fixing bugs, I don’t feel tired, I feel very happy
Thank you for recording the video and disseminating it. With your sharing, more friends can see our work.
Thank you for helping us to plan and write strategies. With your feedback, we can free up more time for us to devote to game adjustments.
"Forbidden Trial" is a baby in swaddling, very fragile and sensitive. It is with your tolerance and encouragement that it will gradually become stronger and better! On behalf of the entire development team, I would like to express my sincere thanks to you!

[b]Let’s talk about our future plans~[/b]
After optimizing the game and fixing bugs during the launch period, our current development energy has begun to shift to the production of new content. The update plan for the next version is as follows:

[b]How to update[/b]
1. Added a new genre effect, and the corresponding full set of blessings and rune enhancements;
2. A batch of new rune runes are added. The new rune runes are more powerful. Compared with the basic rune runes, a random sub-attribute affix will be added. At the same time, there are special rune strengthening skills for new runes (also will combine the core construction skills in the purple quality in the old runes);
3. After difficulty level 20, daily challenges are unlocked and affix effects are fixed. Daily challenges that reach four difficulty levels of 20, 30, 50, and 70 will get a new version of the rune treasure chest;
4. After difficulty 30, unlock two new random maps and enemies, and corresponding portals will randomly appear in the second half of Chapter 4. Special mode, the gameplay is temporarily kept secret. In addition to daily challenges, the new version of runes is mainly produced in this mode;
5. After the difficulty is 50, the function of smelting runes will be unlocked.

[b]Other updates[/b]
1. Add two new characters;
2. New camera mode, you can customize Pose;
3. Complete the defeat screen of some characters.

The new version will be released as soon as possible after it is produced.

[b] Our goal is the sea of stars! Although youth is gone, we are still passionate! [/b]
